notes.title: Skystead Ranch V1.1.20 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Skystead Ranch V1.1.20 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New "[b]Recycler[/b]" buildable object. This new buildable allows you to place an object and grind it down to get resources from it.
[*] A new gentle giant has been added to the world. 🐳
[*] 3 New cooking items have been added [list]
[*] [b]Junk Food[/b] - Created by cooking three items with the Junk Tag in the Grill.
[*] [b]Riverweed Paste[/b] - Created by putting riverweed in the Squisher.
[*] [b]Chopped Riverweed[/b] - Created by putting Riverweed in the Chopper. [/list][/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes and Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Grumble's favourite food to the new Junk Food item.
[*] Timer indicators for cooking, buildable and firepits no longer cast shadows.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't use the pause menu in the cave (again).
[*] Fixed an issue where objects with additional spice tags would sometimes not stack properly in chests.
[*] Added icons in the chest UI that make it easier to spot which items have been given additional tags.
[*] When using a controller, the spell select wheels can now be backed out of by pressing B.
[*] Many Cooking Fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Skystead Ranch V1.1.15 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Skystead Ranch V1.1.15 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New "Move Skylet" Spell[/b] - Available to purchase fairly early in the game. This new utility spell allows you to pick up and move Skylets about your Skystead. Note that Skylets will break out of the spell if you try to move them to areas where they don't want to be (we don't want you dropping them off the edge). Hopefully, this highly requested spell will help people shift Skylets that are trying to escape downstairs 🙂
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixing and Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller is now fully working as intended in the keeper shops.
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller UI selection wasn't working in the pause menu or Settings menu in the cave.
[*] You can now use Q+E or controller equivalents to change the size of the rock terraforming tool as intended.
[*] You can now close crook spell selection menus by pressing B (or whatever non xbox button layout you might have).
[*] Many Skylet requirement changes to better balance and ensure all Skylets are available to unlock.
[*] Spore[list]
[*] Max food amount has been increased from 5 to 12 (and the food burndown rate adjusted accordingly) to prevent Spore from being fully fed from 1 or 2 items with the Mushroom tag.
[*] Added Nocturnal tag.
[*] Changed preferred Day Type to Night.[/list]
[*] Truffle[list]
[*] Added Nocturnal tag.
[*] Changed preferred Day Type to Night.[/list]
[*] Loona[list]
[*] Changed Spawn Condition requirement from ">= 1 Fire" to "<= 1 Fire" to stop conflicts with its own Wandering and Taming requirements.[/list]
[*] Spook
[list][*] Changed Tame Condition from ">= 2 Fire" to >= 2 Light" to stop conflicts with Loona for Wendi's multiple Nocturnal Spawn requirements.[/list]
[*] Snarl
[list][*] Changed Tame Condition requirement from "= 0% Rock" to ">= 10% Rock" to stop conflicts with Fjord's Tame Condition requirements (Both Dinos are needed on the same island for the Dino achievement).[/list]
[*] Mewmew
[list][*] Added Nocturnal tag.
[*] Set preferred Day Type to Night. [/list]
[*] Wendi
[list][*] Reduced Spawn Condition from ">=10% Meadows" to ">=5%" Meadows
[*] Increased Tame Condition from ">=0% Meadows" to ">=12% Meadows"
[/list][*] Many AI configuration changes to improve Skylets sleep behaviour.
[list][*] All Nocturnal Skylets now sleep during the middle of the day and will be active at night, this will fix the spawning/de-spawning issue seen with most Night time Skylets and make the nighttime on your Ranch more active.
[*] All Day Time Skylets now sleep for the entirety of the night.
[*] Skylets who like Both day and night have more unique sleeping patterns. Some will sleep during the morning, some later in the day and some at night, keep an eye on your favourite Skylet to work out when it goes to bed!
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: February Developer Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's been a busy few weeks![/h1]
We want to say another massive, heartfelt thank you to all of you for playing, reviewing and enjoying our game! We have been hard at work addressing all of your feedback and hope you've been enjoying the improvements we've been implementing to Skystead Ranch.

From the now usable chests, new camera controls and numerous bug fixes, we are proud of what we have been able to add to Skystead Ranch in a few short weeks! We hope you've enjoyed these changes too and would love to hear your thoughts on what we've implemented as we believe there is always room for improvement! 💖

Here's a breakdown of what else we've been working on and what to expect in the coming weeks.

[h1]Preparations Begin for Sky Island Events and Parties![/h1]
Something that has been on the roadmap for Skystead Ranch since almost the beginning, is seasons events! With Easter just around the corner, we have begun preparations for the first major in-game event!

Firstly, we need a place for the events to be delivered! Check out the new Event Pier large buildable spot that Laura is working on, it's still a work in progress so check it out in the game when the events begin to see the final product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/08accb0a2d94793b8892be492b08b89ffd9017b4.png[/img]
[h2]Yolk[/h2]
With the first event being our Easter Eggstravaganza, we of course are adding an Egg-based Skylet! Check our Yolk which Jack created on stream last week! The VOD of this stream is available on our YouTube if you want to see more in-depth behind-the-scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/4a386b82f0b6595e19c750a24a7b1372807827fe.png[/img]
We don't want to give too much away about the event before it goes live, so check back in April to see what magical activities we have in store for you!

[h1]A Free Beach Island Update[/h1]
A huge thank you once again to our Kickstarter backers who got us over the line for our Beach Island stretch goal! With your help, we are now able to create a whole new island for you all to play on and find even more exotic Skylets!

Coming in the next couple of months is a whole new, free addition to Skystead Ranch. Make sure you have the lift and water wheel built to take the trip down to the beach along with brand new Sand and Deep Water spells! 😎

These new spells will be crucial for you to attract a whole new array of Skylets! Jack is working hard right now to get these cute additions ready! If it loves the hot sands or cool deep water, you can expect to find it with the new additions to your spell book!

This is Nessi, a large, water-based Skylet that you will have to learn how to attract and befriend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/2e8810a391b92a21e73a2220bafa826d2e4dcaac.png[/img]

As you can see, they are still a work in progress (hence not having any eyes yet!), but it hopefully gives you an idea of what you can expect with this free addition coming soon!

[h1]Player House Progress[/h1]
Another big request from you all is the player house which we are very excited to get working as we planned! Laura has been crafting a variety of in-house furniture for you all to buy and build when the house becomes usable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/f4b079943c1dbe527949be14a66860c63898e494.png[/img]
You'll notice there are a variety of beds, this is due to the request from players to be able to pass the time quicker when you want day or night to come back around! We didn't originally plan for the ability to skip time in Skystead Ranch but your request for this makes sense to us and so Laura is laying the groundwork for Rob to add this with the rest of the house implementation.

Let us know what you think of the designs!

[h1]What's Coming Next?[/h1]
We're working around the clock to get the roadmap promises implemented along with all of the important bug fixing, so thank you all for your patience in getting this ready! We still have a few bits to do to get up-to-date with the roadmap and these will be getting added in the coming updates.

Rob our programmer is taking a much-needed break over March since he is over 200 hours over his work hours! That's real dedication and we know he needs to take time to fully relax and recuperate. This means there won't be any updates throughout next month, but you can expect to see a whole bunch of big exciting things in April when he's back and ready to go!

Thank you for your understanding and we wish Rob the best break ever to get back to normal! 💖

[h2]Skystead Merch[/h2]
A little treat we've been working on outside of game development is some Skystead Ranch-related merch! From embroidered hats to mugs and posters, we have some exciting things in the pipeline! Keep an eye on our news and website for when these go live to purchase so you can represent your Skylets outside of your Ranch!

[h1]Patch Notes V1.0.41[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Settings Menu now supports controller!
[*] Added press and hold functionality to quickly navigate UI with a controller.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes and Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped Skylet info cards from appearing in the cave.
[*] Skylets can no longer get stuck on any of the Kitchen equipment.
[*] Corrected a typo in the Roadmap screen.
[*] Removed additional engine light from the Sky Island Light object. Now only toon lighting exists as intended.
[*] The cooker now uses toon lighting when activated.
[*] Fixed a bug where when building an object, the forward direction of the object was visible when it shouldn't and vice versa. For example, the Fishing Hole no longer shows this arrow and the Simple Sundial now does.
[*] Fixed a bug where some users got locked into a position where they didn't own the Rock Spell but it was tagged as purchased.
[*] Fixed a bug where purchasing a new buildable item in the shop could sometimes allow you to access an object you shouldn't have access to.
[*] The buildable objects tab in the shop now is split into two sections (purchased and available to purchase). Very much like the Spells tab and the Large Buildable tab, hopefully, this makes the page a lot more satisfying as you can visually see how much you have progressed on this screen.
[*] The Watering Can is now fixed. This is an item that we were using for giveaways for launch. If anyone wants a key for one of these, just message either Toastie_Lee or Toastie_Rob in our Discord 🙂
[*] Minor issue but the default text for which terraforming mode you are in when you first enter the cave now defaults to the intended "Earth".
[*] Fixed a bug where some settings menu items weren't accessible on a controller.
[*] Many controller camera inputs have changed to give better control and to better support the free-look camera setting.
[*] The rail bolts on the cave entrance asset no longer have flipped normals.
[*] Disabled the wind movement effect on the smaller tree asset because the base of the trunk was moving back and forth when it shouldn't.
[*] Fixed an issue with Nomshroom Item causing the player to be pushed around
[*] Fixed the hit box of the Growl Hut so you can walk inside.
[/list]

notes.title: Farming Fest Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Farming Fest So Far[/h1]
Thank you so much for stopping by during the Steam Farming Fest! It has been great so far and we're only halfway through the week.

2000 of you have picked up the demo for the first time this week and for a small indie studio like ours, that means a lot! Thank you 💓

Make sure you wishlist the game once you've given it a try!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399570

[h2]Activities[/h2]
We still have our Farming Fest extracurricular activities running in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/toastielabs-750363631279014079]Discord[/url]! 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/52c37fa408f8fee9f3bfad61aea1861adb42ef00.png[/img]

Make sure to stop by to chat with the devs and other players!

[h1]Starting Game Economy[/h1]
We spent some time this week editing and balancing the in-game economy! Nothing too drastic just yet, but we have been editing the build values of all of the buildable items and how many resources you get from your crops and trees!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/be122e10bc2900334b2e7d81a7413eb3c567bbbd.png[/img]

We recognise there isn't a reliable method to gather the stone resource just yet, so we are looking to design some kind of "Rock tree" that will allow you to farm both types of building resources.

[h2]Bug Fixing and Feedback[/h2]
Various bugs have been listed in our Discord, and our programmer Rob has been hard at work addressing the most important of these, so thank you for your help finding and diagnosing these pesky problems! Please keep them coming!

Don't forget to hit that "Questionnaire" button in-game too, and let us know about your experience. Feedback is very important at this stage of development.


Thank you all once again, let's keep Ranching! 🧑‍🌾

notes.title: Development Update - April
notes.notes:
[h1]Farming Fest[/h1]
Big news! We're taking part in the Steam Farming Fest this month!

An opportunity to celebrate one of our favourite game genres - Farming! As Skystead Ranch has a large element of Farming we thought this would be the perfect opportunity for you all to try out the current game in a demo format.

That's right, at the end of this month, from the 26th of April to the 6th of May, Skystead Ranch will be available to download and play as a free Demo! Make sure you try it and let us know what you think.

[h1]New Skylets[/h1]
Since last time, we have 6 exciting new Skylets in various stages of development! The new skylets are to fit a variety of gameplay roles as we introduce new themed zones.

Some are very small, some can even fly, but all of them are as cute as can be!

[i][b]From left to right:[/b] Sizzle, Puffle, Tor, Bigby, Snarl[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/138db69164e724b8e23698b8c82897ad99ad864f.png[/img]

"Shiny" skin variants are also in the works as we are also improving upon the rare Skylet spawning! We have been changing up the colour pallet and adding emissive textures to give them that extra rare glow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/4d73f0caa5b6d3d10b7f0c0133723a71baf1a89f.png[/img]

[h1]New zones[/h1]
Our artist Laura has been hard at work making 2 new zones for you to play in the demo!

[h2]House Zone[/h2]
The House Zone is situated above the starting island and comes with your very own humble abode! The purpose of this island is to be more of a player hub, where you can upgrade your house, customise the area with decorations and even do some fishing and cooking! (Fishing and cooking aren't implemented just yet)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/0a079388ed0c6e13e1b40eed96df2f84fe2a3803.png[/img]

[h2]Forest Zone[/h2]
The second of the playable zones, like the starting island, is designed for you to farm, upgrade and discover new Skylets! The forest zone will be more lush than the first island with vibrant trees, dense undergrowth and all the wonderful Skylets that come with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/3e7caa797619f88a1fe2505d849ffeef2ea72a6c.png[/img]

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
With all the new additions to the game from the art department, we have been making sure we don't fall behind on the technical side too! Our programmer has been hard at work ensuring the frame rate, loading times, and other performance requirements are as polished as they can be.

One big step was reworking the 3D grass model! Updates to the grass shaders allow for lifelike movement without taxing the drivers and a change in the way the grass is rendered allows us to have a lot more grass density for a lot less performance cost.

Just look at that sweet grass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/fa79ccfb96d050f09302faabe1281655b479b813.png[/img]

[h1]Steam Deck and Controller Support[/h1]
Our motivation for performance improvement was twofold. It is important for us to provide a better game overall, but we are also excited to make sure Skystead Ranch is console-ready too!

We officially have a Steam Deck here at ToastieLabs! What that means is we are now able to officially support Skystead Ranch (and our other games) on the Steam Deck as we can do in-house QA testing on the Deck which we weren't able to do before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/7e3d01bccfccacbe39a08ac1106f62a23c5ac2b2.png[/img]

With plans for Skystead Ranch releasing on the Steam Deck and Nintendo Switch, we have begun work on controller support as well as classic keyboard and mouse. Make sure you plug in your controller or play on your Steam Deck this month when the Demo goes live and let us know what you think!

[h1]New Controls[/h1]
"With controller support comes new controls" - Uncle Ben or something

[h2]Camera Controls[/h2]
Taking your feedback on board from the Next Fest back in October, as well as considering the player experience when playing with a controller, we have completely overhauled the player camera for Skystead Ranch.
No longer is the game a top-down one-directional camera, but is now a 3rd Person camera with full 360-degree control! 

We're still working out the kinks when it comes to camera movement sensitivity, but the overall feel is much better for Skystead Ranch and we are very happy with the change. (Even if it does mean more work for the artists to fix the backs of the island that you couldn't see before, sorry Jack and Laura!)

[h2]Crook Controls [/h2]
The next set of controls to overhaul was the crook controls. The ability to dig holes, clear the earth and build items needed to be redesigned to fit with the new camera and controller support system. 

An updated building UI has been added which makes the building flow much easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/b4913df1e4dac4bafebbbd2521887c80b7e66d85.png[/img]
A lot of work is still needed to make sure this is ready for the demo, so best of luck to our programmer Rob!

[h1]Localisation[/h1]
To all of you non-native English speakers, we are very proud to announce that work has officially begun on localising Skystead Ranch.
The store pages and the base game are now translated into 11 additional languages!
[i]Please note: All of the localising still needs a thorough QA so there may be an issue or 2 until we get that all fixed for you.[/i]

[h2]Localised Languages: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Chinese Simplified
[*] Chinese Traditional
[*] Dutch
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/ecd468a30f6d4c0fd92ca374a146c2f91db247ad.png[/img]
[h1]Your Turn![/h1]
Thank you for following our progress with Skystead Ranch! We invite you to play the demo from the 26th and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399570/Skystead_Ranch/

The game is still in early access so your feedback is very important to us. After trying the game, press the "Discord" and "Questionnaire" buttons on the game's main menu and let us know what you think in as much or as little detail as you like.

Thank you! 💖

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]January Development[/h1]
We've hit the ground running as we are starting 2024! To make the game as good as we can, we started this January by stripping down the demo you got to try last October back to the basics.

This allows us to have a second pass on everything, and ensure all files are in the correct place and following the right structure - overall, allowing for a better, more optimised game!
This is also the perfect opportunity to take your feedback on board and revisit some of the game fundamentals like the art style and game feel.

[h2]Publishers?[/h2]
Alongside the technical development, we are still in talks with various organisations to see about getting a publisher for Skystead Ranch, we are still hopeful of finding a publisher that aligns with our company values. We can't say much more on this at the moment, but will keep you all updated with any news we can announce.

[h1]New Artist[/h1]
The biggest news for ToastieLabs and Skystead Ranch this year so far, is our newest 3D Artist Laura! Going from 1 artist to 2 will greatly increase the quality and quantity of the assets we can create to flesh out the fantastical world of Skystead Ranch!

Laura is already settling in well with the team and has started strong with these new 3D models for the game! Her amazing work lets Jack focus his efforts on making many more unique Skylets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/fffd4b9671e776397baea757d9bec976867c6eb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/8f54777c0cf6309c54c5c3cf84f9576e3247121e.jpg[/img]

[h1]World Block Out & Art Pass[/h1]
A large part of the development is revising the world layout, we concluded from the game Demo, that the starting world layout was far too large for tutorial purposes, with this in mind we have blocked out a brand new island layout, with the player house completely separate to the Skylet play area!

We are excited about the possibilities this unlocks from a gameplay point of view and are excited for you all to try it for yourselves in future demonstrations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/01ac82d14186af74544a4a6c4c475c015b51c255.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/2f0b2840555777b5ef1beb45a6454bddf87edaae.png[/img]

We put additional early development effort into the starting island to allow us to pass on the revisited art style to the publishers we are talking with. It's looking more and more like how we envisioned Skystead to look when we initially designed the game concept. Specifically the revised toon shaders we are using for the Skylets and improved lighting make for a much more cosy experience than we demonstrated in the demo. We also have a couple of new Sky Ships if you look closely.

Make sure you follow us on Steam and on our socials to stay up-to-date with the development process as we continue to make Skystead Ranch! We're still on track for release in early 2025!

notes.title: Voice Over, SFX and getting ready for the Demo release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Game Progress[/h1]
Since last month, we have made so much progress with Skystead Ranch! The Demo is very nearly complete, just in time for the Demo launch date and Kickstarter next week!

[h2]Tutorial Voice Over[/h2]
We have contracted a voice actor with a magnificent Scottish accent to provide a full voice-over for Skystead Ranch! Currently, that's just the game tutorial plus a couple of smaller lines here and there for when the player does certain actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/044743b082c7dc3cd4806de4bccadc6804207b3a.jpg[/img]
The simple but considerable addition of a voice actor has greatly increased the quality of the tutorial as you now have a helpful guide to start your adventure with.


[h2]Sound Effects![/h2]
On the same topic, we have added a variety of sound effects!
These range from ambient noise for crackling fires, running water and the flying Skyboats to individual voices and sounds for all of the various creatures you will encounter whilst you play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/720c18051d339e176cbb0028f61774e5429ea070.jpg[/img]
Play the demo to find out how each cute creature sounds!


[h2]Getting Demo Ready[/h2]
Serious QA testing has been taking place over the past few weeks, you may have caught some of the testing live on our Twitch channel! Make sure you follow us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/toastielabs]Twitch[/url] to get notified of when we go live as we will be streaming a lot more Skystread Ranch content over the coming weeks.

The QA Testing has been vital for getting an in-depth list of bug fixes for our programmer Rob to work on. From minor audio bugs to game-breaking tutorial bugs, we have fixed so much in order to make the Demo experience as smooth as possible for everyone who plays!


[h1]Weekly Schedules and Next Fest[/h1]
October is going to be busy!
Keep an eye on all of our socials as well as this forum here in Steam as we are going to be posting a schedule every Friday to let you know what competitions, activities, livestreams and more we will be hosting on a daily basis all throughout the month of October!

[h2]Next Fest[/h2]
A part of this plan is the October Next Fest! Starting October 9th, we will be taking part in the October Next Fest to demonstrate what Skystead Ranch has to offer! Mark the week in your calendar as there will be Steam Broadcasts, a playable Demo and so much more to take part in all throughout the Next Fest week of festivities!


[h1]Kickstarter[/h1]
We are very close to the campaign going live! There are only 8 days to go until you can support the game development and get some rewards in return!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/toastielabs/skystead-ranch][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/eb89d54a984e62e6b679ab50598401b65804bddf.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click me ^[/i]

Ensure you follow the campaign to get notified the moment we go live so you can check out all of the exclusive backer rewards on offer!

Your support (even just sharing the link on your Socials) still means the world to us and will allow us to provide the best game we can for everyone. Thank you so much once again to all those who have already followed the campaign! <3
